The application image (5deee74c…), the rel-v4 wire protocol, the operator contract, the seeds and the all-self-reporting audit policy the calibrations ran under are unchanged, so nothing v0.7 changes lies inside the measured period. The import relaxes the preregistration hash and nothing else: image, protocol, session, mode, seed, operator contract and the three input files are still compared to the current pins by host/l6_runner.plan_session, and the (version, sha256) pair is verified against prereg.supersedes.
